incidents.text: David Wolfe feeds the ball through to Erling Haaland (Norway), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the top right corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 0:1!
Goal! Aymen Hussein (Iraq) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Amir Al Ammari and easily beat the keeper with a header into the right side of the goal from close range. 1:1.
GOAL! Keeper Jalal Hassan totally miss kicks his clearance straight to Erling Haaland (Norway), who rifles the ball back into the net from close range. It’s now 1:2.
Graham Arnold has decided to make a change. Zidane Iqbal (Iraq) replaces Zaid Ismaeel.
The game has come to an end for Ali Al Hamadi. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Marko Farji (Iraq).
Substitution. Antonio Nusa leaves the pitch and is replaced by Andreas Schjelderup (Norway).
Stale Solbakken decides to make a substitution. Fredrik Aursnes will be replaced by Kristian Thorstvedt (Norway).
Here is a change. David Wolfe is going off and Stale Solbakken gives the last tactical orders to Leo Ostigard (Norway).
Substitution. Alexander Sorloth is replaced by Oscar Bobb (Norway).
Substitution. Mustafa Saadoon (Iraq) replaces Hussein Ali.
Ali Jasim (Iraq) is substituted due to injury. Graham Arnold gives a chance to Ahmed Qasem.

Leo Ostigard (Norway) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the resulting corner and scores with a great header into the roof of the net. The goalkeeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:3.
The substitution has been made. Meme (Iraq) has replaced Ibrahim Bayesh.
Stale Solbakken has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Patrick Berg (Norway) replacing Martin Odegaard.
Zaid Tahseen (Iraq) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
Aymen Hussein (Iraq) attempts to head the ball away after a cross into the penalty area, but instead he accidentally sends it inside the right post of his own goal. The goalkeeper was helpless.
